recommended_pick.name: The Reservations Desk Answer Layer. One funded build with no AI in it, plus a written, numerically gated option on retrieval.
recommended_pick.one_line: Fund the decision table, the authoritative vessel to departure source, the corpus reconciliation and the miss log. Write the retrieval option down with a number on its gate and let the season decide whether it is ever exercised.
what_changed_from_the_provisional_pick: Two funded phases becomes ONE funded build plus a priced OPTION. This is the change that answers the smuggling charge, because an option that fails closed is a different commercial object from a phase that has already been sold.

Corpus reconciliation moves from unstated to a named phase one deliverable with an internal owner, because retrieval over a corpus that contradicts itself is the largest hidden risk in the original scope and it was not costed.
The retrieval option starts at SNIPPET SEARCH with the verbatim published sentence, not at grounded generation. Generation becomes a third rung with its own gate.
The vessel to departure map is named as data that DOES NOT EXIST YET, with an owner and a date, and an abstain route if it turns out not to be stable.

The miss log gains a labelling budget, a held-out split, deliberate out of corpus cases, a sampling arm to correct its own selection bias, and a PII rule. Without those it is a backlog wearing an eval set's coat.
A paper tally sheet starts NOW, in the final nine weeks of the 2026 season, so the baseline exists before anything is built.

THE TIMELINE IS CORRECTED. Phase one lands before the March 2027 cohort. Retrieval, if it is ever earned, is a 2028 season tool, because the questions that would justify it can only be collected while a season runs.
recommended_pick.why_it_survives: The funded part can be CERTIFIED rather than estimated. The input space is finite, the answers are already published by the company itself, and the acceptance bar is 100 percent on an exhaustive enumeration rather than a threshold on a sample somebody has to trust. It attacks the four questions with the highest cost of error with the one technology class that has no hallucination surface. It creates three assets the company keeps regardless, one canonical policy source, one authoritative vessel map, and a written record of what their own desk actually gets asked. It is aimed at a workforce that is structurally novice every spring by the company's own published hiring facts. And it is honest about its own size. Absolute hours saved are modest because the desk is small, so this is a ramp time and error rate case that recurs every spring, not a headcount case.

where_we_would_not_use_ai: No model touches your refund clocks, your change fee, a wheelchair question, shuttle eligibility or a dietary window. Those five are finite, already written on your own pages, and expensive when they are wrong, so they run on a decision table we can test against every possible input and that hands the agent the exact published sentence to read out loud. A model would answer them a little more smoothly and a little less reliably, and on the 8:00 a.m. shuttle exclusion a little less reliably means a guest plans around a pickup that never comes, walks 0.6 miles with luggage, misses the sailing, and is a no-show, which your own policy makes completely non-refundable. We would not use a model to write a disruption notice either, because you want that message identical every time and a template is identical by construction while a model is only identical when supervised. We would not point anything at a guest until the internal version has a full season of evidence behind it. And the first thing we would build is not software at all, it is a tally sheet on the desk for the rest of this season, because right now nobody is counting the thing we would be paid to improve.

ladder_walk.reasoning: The strategist put generation on the same rung as retrieval and never separated them, which skips a rung. The actual failure of a first-week hire is not an inability to read, it is not knowing which of roughly thirty pages holds the answer at 4:40 p.m. on a Sunday. Hybrid lexical plus semantic search returning the verbatim sentence and the page solves that exact failure with no generation step and no hallucination surface. Generation adds a second fallible step and DEGRADES the human check, because a fluent paraphrase carrying a real citation is much harder for a novice to challenge than a snippet that plainly does not match. Downscope to snippet retrieval, verbatim source mandatory, no composed prose. A hard topic filter enforced IN CODE must route refunds, accessibility, shuttle eligibility and dietary windows to the table rather than to search. Gated behind corpus reconciliation.

The lowest rung and it clears the bar outright on the highest cost of error questions in the business. The one component whose acceptance bar can be CERTIFIED rather than sampled, because the input cross product is finite and testable to 100 percent. Two scope corrections. The accessibility branch depends on a vessel to departure map that does not exist in verified published form and may not exist internally in one place either, so that map is a deliverable with a named internal owner and a date, and where the vessel is not known the table ABSTAINS. And the booking engine vendor is unidentified and may never be guessed, so phase one is a standalone tool where the agent enters booking contents by hand. Saying that keeps the one person month estimate honest instead of hiding an integration nobody has scoped.

Killed, and NOT because of AI, there is no AI in it. Three independent grounds. The booking vendor is unidentified and may not be guessed, so the integration surface can't be scoped and any effort number would be invented. Package volume and value are unpublished, so the revenue ceiling is a guess with no denominator. And phone-only sits next to a verified direct-only discount rule and a named Director of Sales, which is at least as consistent with a deliberate margin and upsell decision as with a defect. Proposing to remove a revenue mechanism while calling it a fix is the sharpening reflex applied to strategy instead of to a quote.

Downscoped from first move to Later, gated, not killed. The honest case FOR is real, it is the only candidate with a named measured comparable in the same category and it serves guests outside the 8 to 6 window. The case against as a FIRST move is stronger. 10 staff hours a month at a roughly 100 passenger operator is a fraction of one shift, and 60 percent answered means 40 percent were not, which is a handoff problem on the guest side. Above all it places confident wrong answers on the guest side of a thirty year locally owned reputation that is the company's actual defence against a NYSE-listed competitor in the same harbour, before any eval set exists. If ever built, it runs on a whitelist with abstain-to-human as default and never answers a refund, accessibility or shuttle question.

ladder_walk.lowest_rung_that_solves_it: none of the rungs clears the bar for this surface
ladder_walk.reasoning: The problem is not that the build sits too high on the ladder, it is the surface it is pointed at. See voice_agent_verdict.

Downscoped out of existence as a separate product, and FOLDED. Its entitlement math is the same decision table applied to a list. The drafting node is the only place a model was proposed and it is not earned, because the stated goal is CONSISTENCY and a template is consistent by construction while a model is consistent only under supervision. Here AI is worse on the actual objective, not just more expensive. Frequency is the killer, c11 says cruises go out rain or shine and are only cancelled for unsafe sea conditions, and c10's trigger is narrower than it first reads. Count the events for one season first.

kill_list.capability: AI voice agent on the reservations line
kill_list.why_killed: Wrong surface, not merely the wrong rung. The line is a revenue channel where packages are sold and where within-twelve-hours bookings are explicitly routed for a human to take, and its caller mix skews toward guests already in trouble. Measured latency of 1,296 to 1,740ms median across five platforms, none sub 800ms, is a real supporting reason and the WEAKEST of the three, since it is the variable most likely to improve.

kill_list.capability: Guest-facing chatbot as the first move
kill_list.why_killed: Puts confident wrong answers on the guest side of a thirty year locally owned reputation before any eval set exists to measure how often it is confidently wrong. Deferred and gated, not permanently dead.

kill_list.capability: Self-serve package builder in this engagement
kill_list.why_killed: Contains no AI, has an integration surface that can't be scoped because the booking vendor is unidentified, has no published volume denominator, and may be attacking a deliberate sales decision rather than a defect.

kill_list.capability: A model drafting the disruption notification
kill_list.why_killed: The stated goal is consistency. A template with merge fields is consistent by construction, a model is consistent only under supervision. Here AI is worse on the actual objective.

kill_list.capability: Disruption console as a standalone product
kill_list.why_killed: Its entitlement logic is the decision table applied to a list, and its event frequency is unpublished. Count the events for one season on the tally sheet before building anything.

kill_list.capability: Free-text generation on refunds, accessibility, shuttle eligibility and dietary windows
kill_list.why_killed: Highest cost of error, finite input space, published answers. Determinism wins outright. Enforced as a topic filter IN CODE, not as a prompt instruction.

kill_list.capability: Generation layered on retrieval in the funded scope
kill_list.why_killed: Skips a rung. Snippet retrieval with the verbatim sentence solves the stated failure, and adding generation roughly QUADRUPLES the modelled rate at which a wrong answer reaches a guest while buying fluency. Held as a gated third rung with a numeric threshold.
Not AI, it is constraint solving, and there is zero evidence the current staff-assigned process causes anyone pain. Building on speculation is how a project ends with nothing to measure.
It is a crawl, a diff and a link check. No model required. Belongs inside corpus reconciliation as plumbing, never sold as an AI build.

A 61,459 call audit across 12 models measured responding to reviews at +0.1 percentage points on LLM recommendation probability, statistically equivalent to zero, against about +32 pp for guest rating. Stated precisely, that audit measures how MODELS recommend, so it does not prove review responses are worthless to human readers. In the AI recommendation channel specifically, tooling bought to move that needle buys nothing. A stop-doing gift with no invoice attached.

cost_of_error.the_wrong_answer: Quoting the 72 hour cruise-only clock to a guest holding motorcoach or train, which carries a 21 day clock, or the reverse. Also quoting a free date change to someone already on their second, or treating a no-show as changeable.
cost_of_error.what_it_costs: In the generous direction the company refunds money it did not owe on a booking that includes purchased third party transportation it may already be committed to. In the strict direction a guest is refused a refund they were entitled to under the published policy, on a brand whose entire competitive position is being the local family company. Both are real dollars and the strict direction is also public.
cost_of_error.who_catches_it: Nobody in the moment. It surfaces after the money has moved. A first-season agent has no way to detect it, because the wrong clock sounds exactly as authoritative as the right one.

cost_of_error.the_wrong_answer: Telling a wheelchair user a departure is accessible when the vessel running it is not on the accessible list, or omitting that access is first deck inside the main cabin only, or that no vessel takes a motorized wheelchair.
cost_of_error.what_it_costs: The highest cost of error in the business and the only one with a dignity dimension rather than only a dollar one. A guest travels to Seward inside a multi-day itinerary and discovers at the gangway they can't board. Nothing recovers that on the day.
cost_of_error.who_catches_it: NOBODY upstream of the dock. The only error in the set with no intermediate catcher at all.
cost_of_error.ruling: DO NOT USE AI, plus a second guardrail. The table answers only when the vessel serving that departure is known with certainty. Otherwise it ABSTAINS and routes to a named human. Live example of why this is needed rather than decorative, the FAQ names a vessel running the 12:30 pm 4 Hour departure that the eight-vessel fleet page does not list, and the 4 Hour is the product that runs latest in the season.

cost_of_error.the_wrong_answer: Promising the shuttle on the 8:00 a.m. 6 Hour cruise, which is explicitly excluded, or without the 24 hours notice, or without the required advance reservation.
cost_of_error.what_it_costs: The sharpest chain in the business and every link is their own published rule. The guest plans an arrival around a pickup that will not come. The 8:00 a.m. departure has the least slack. The terminal loop runs 7:00 to 9:45 a.m., a partial fallback for a cruise ship guest and none at all for a guest who parked. The walk is 0.6 miles from Harbor 360 and 0.8 from the South Harbor office, with luggage, before an 8:00 a.m. boarding. A guest who misses the sailing is a no-show, and a no-show is completely non-refundable and may not be used on any other sailing. One wrong sentence converts into a total non-recoverable loss for the guest.
cost_of_error.who_catches_it: In principle the confirmation email. In practice the guest, at 7:30 a.m. in a parking lot.

cost_of_error.the_wrong_answer: Telling a 4 Hour guest they can request a vegetarian sandwich when that product has no meal, or accepting a request after the reservation when the published rule is at the time of reservation.
cost_of_error.what_it_costs: Low dollars, real guest experience cost, discovered onboard where nothing can be fixed.
cost_of_error.who_catches_it: The galley, on the day, too late.

cost_of_error.branch: Snippet retrieval over the reconciled corpus (option)
cost_of_error.the_wrong_answer: Surfacing a passage that does not answer the question, or surfacing the stale side of a contradiction.
cost_of_error.what_it_costs: Individually low, because this rung only serves the long tail after the four high cost branches are filtered to the table. The stale contradiction case is the exception and is why reconciliation is a precondition, since a wrong number carrying a genuine citation reads as MORE verified than a wrong number with none.
cost_of_error.who_catches_it: The employee, and only if the tool shows the verbatim sentence and its URL rather than a paraphrase. That human filter is the entire safety argument, and it collapses the moment the tool is pointed at a guest or allowed to compose prose.
cost_of_error.ruling: USE, WRAPPED IN HUMAN REVIEW BY CONSTRUCTION.

data_readiness.the_good_half: Genuinely good and worth saying plainly. The corpus exists, is small and bounded at roughly thirty public pages, is plain HTML rather than locked in a PDF or a phone system, is owned outright, contains no PII, and is already written in the company's own voice. That removes the EXISTENCE half of the number two cause of AI project failure before the project starts, which is rarer than it sounds.
data_readiness.the_bad_half: DISQUALIFYING FOR RETRIEVAL AS IT STANDS TODAY. The corpus contradicts itself, at a rate found by one afternoon of external reading. Two pages give different parking prices. A live 2026 booking page carries copy saying a departure is new in 2021 and unavailable in 2020. The FAQ names a vessel running a scheduled 12:30 pm departure that the fleet page does not list. A product with a live 2026 page is missing from the five-product index. FOUR independent freshness and consistency defects in a corpus that small is not a list of typos, it is a measured defect rate, and it decides how this build is sequenced.
data_readiness.why_it_matters_more_for_retrieval: Retrieval has NO MECHANISM for resolving a contradiction. Given two conflicting passages it returns whichever ranks higher, and if generation is layered on top it will cite a real page for a wrong number. That is the worst available failure mode, because the citation is what makes the answer look checked. A citation is a guarantee of provenance and NEVER a guarantee of correctness, and on this corpus the gap is a coin flip on the parking price. Retrieval over an unreconciled corpus does not fail loudly, it fails plausibly.
data_readiness.the_harder_problem_nobody_named: TWO SEASONS ARE LIVE AT ONCE. The 4 Hour Kenai Fjords Wildlife Cruise is $149 for 2026 and the 4 Hour Spring Wildlife Cruise is already published at $109 for March to May 2027. So 'what does the 4 Hour cost' has two correct answers and a naive index will pick one. Season scoping of every dated and priced fact is a required design element, not a refinement, and it recurs annually.
data_readiness.what_this_means_for_scope: Corpus reconciliation is PHASE ONE WORK, before any retrieval, and it is the largest item of hidden scope in the whole proposal. It is not a modelling job, it is a content operations job. It needs a crawl that finds every conflicting statement, a named internal owner who adjudicates each one because only they know which parking price is right, one canonical versioned source with a date, and a review cadence with a real trigger, at minimum before March 7 each season and after any price or schedule change. Doing this has standalone value whether or not a line of AI is ever written.
data_readiness.the_data_asset_that_does_not_exist_at_al: THE VESSEL TO DEPARTURE MAP. Nothing public provides it, and the FAQ versus fleet page disagreement is direct evidence that internally it lives in more than one head or file and the copies disagree. Every accessibility, seating and capacity answer depends on it. It may also not be static, since vessel assignment plausibly moves with maintenance and charters, and if it is not stable the honest design is that the tool NEVER answers accessibility and routes it to a named person. That dependency has an owner and a date or the accessibility branch does not ship.
data_readiness.the_miss_log_is_a_governance_object: It will capture guest questions verbatim, which means names, booking references, mobility information and dietary information. Mobility and dietary details are health adjacent personal data. The log needs field level discipline or redaction at capture, a retention rule, and a decision about who may read it, agreed BEFORE the first entry is written.
data_readiness.booking_system: The vendor is unidentified and may not be named or guessed, so no integration is scopeable from public facts and phase one is a standalone tool with manual entry of booking contents.
data_readiness.baseline_data: Median time to answer, escalation rate and misquote count are not recorded anywhere today. There is NO BASELINE to improve on until somebody starts counting, so the first deliverable is a PAPER TALLY SHEET at the desk, not software. If they will not run the tally, the outcome is unmeasurable and the study must say so rather than promise a measured result.

compounding_error_math.note: All per-step figures are STATED ASSUMPTIONS used to size a design decision, never measurements of anything at Major Marine.
compounding_error_math.rung_1_decision_table: One deterministic step. End to end reliability on enumerated inputs is 1.00 by construction. Residual risk is not probabilistic, it is two named dependencies, whether the encoded rules match the published policy on the day, and whether the vessel map is current. Both checkable by inspection rather than sampling. The only component that can be CERTIFIED.
compounding_error_math.rung_2_snippet_retrieval_no_generation: One fallible step, the ranking. Assume retrieval hit at top three on a bounded reconciled corpus at 0.92. The agent reads the snippet and a snippet that does not address the question is visibly obvious, so assume agent catch at 0.85. Probability a wrong answer reaches a guest is 0.08 x 0.15 = 0.012, about one in eighty three.
compounding_error_math.rung_3_retrieval_plus_generation: Two fallible steps. 0.92 x 0.95 = 0.874, so about one answer in eight is wrong or unsupported before any human sees it. The human filter also gets WEAKER at this rung, because a fluent paraphrase carrying a real citation is far harder for a first season hire to challenge. Assume agent catch falls from 0.85 to 0.60. Probability a wrong answer reaches a guest is 0.126 x 0.40 = 0.050, about one in twenty.
compounding_error_math.the_comparison_is_the_argument: Rung three is roughly FOUR TIMES WORSE than rung two on the only number that matters, and what it buys is fluency. That is why generation is a gated third rung and not part of the funded build.
compounding_error_math.in_the_owners_units: At twenty questions per agent per day, rung two produces about one wrong answer reaching a guest per agent every four working days. Rung three produces about one per agent per day, roughly five a week per agent. Say that instead of 'ninety percent accurate', because ninety percent accurate is a number nobody can act on.
compounding_error_math.voice_agent: A booking or policy call is not one turn. Assume twelve turns at an assumed 0.97 per turn, end to end task success is 0.97^12, about 0.69. Nearly a third of calls go wrong somewhere. Layer measured latency on top and twelve turns adds roughly 17 seconds of dead air per call at the median and 24 to 27 seconds at the measured p95 range.

phase_one_decision_table.acceptance_metric: Two HARD metrics, pass or fail rather than thresholds. One, 100 percent agreement with published policy across an EXHAUSTIVE enumeration of the input cross product, not a sample. Two, the tool never returns an answer without the verbatim published sentence and its source URL attached, checked as an assertion on every response.
phase_one_decision_table.eval_set: The enumerated cell table itself, every cell carrying the published answer, signed off by a named internal policy owner before the tool ships. A regression suite, re-run on every content change and before March 7 each season. NOT a sampled eval set, a specification, which is the advantage of staying on the rules rung.
phase_one_decision_table.human_review_path: The human is inside the loop by construction, since the agent reads the returned published sentence to the guest rather than the tool speaking to anyone.
phase_one_decision_table.fallback: DEFAULT DENY. Any input combination not in the table returns 'no published rule for this case, escalate to the named role' and writes a miss log entry. It never interpolates and never guesses. The accessibility branch additionally abstains whenever the vessel serving a departure is not known with certainty.

business_outcome_measurement.acceptance_metric: A fall in all three of median time to answer, escalation rate for first season agents, and count of policy misquotes reaching a guest, with no fall in guest experience.
business_outcome_measurement.eval_set: THERE IS NO BASELINE TODAY, so this is a deliverable and not an assumption. A paper tally sheet at the desk for the final nine weeks of the 2026 season, running from now to October 11. Zero software, zero cost, and it does three jobs at once, it establishes the baseline, it counts the disruption events that decide whether the console is ever worth building, and it starts the miss log before any tool exists. Re-measured in the same calendar weeks of 2027.
business_outcome_measurement.fallback: If they will not run the tally, the honest position is that the outcome can't be measured and the study says so rather than promising a measured improvement. An unmeasurable claim is not a smaller claim, it is a different kind of claim.

retrieval_option_if_the_gate_clears.acceptance_metric: Three metrics, all pre-committed IN WRITING before any build. Grounded correctness on the held-out labelled set, target at least 90 percent. ABSTENTION RECALL on a deliberately constructed out of corpus set, target at least 95 percent, and this matters more, because the confident wrong answer is the only failure mode that hurts and a system that never says it does not know is unsafe at any accuracy. Zero tolerance on a red list, no output of any kind on refund amounts and clocks, accessibility by vessel, shuttle eligibility and dietary windows, enforced by a topic filter IN CODE before the retriever is called.
retrieval_option_if_the_gate_clears.eval_set: At least 150 labelled real questions from the miss log with a held-out split never touched during development, plus at least 50 constructed abstention cases, plus at least 30 items per major question type. Labels produced by a named internal authority, not by us and not by a model. Re-labelled each season.
retrieval_option_if_the_gate_clears.human_review_path: Staff facing ONLY, never guest facing. Verbatim source and URL on every result. A named policy owner reviews a random sample weekly for the first six weeks, drawn independently of what agents chose to flag.
retrieval_option_if_the_gate_clears.fallback: Abstain and escalate to a named role, and log it. A kill switch reverting to the decision table alone, TESTED before launch rather than assumed.

evaluation_plan.the_bar: If any of the four items above can't be stated for a component, that component is a demo and not a build, and it does not get funded. Phase one clears all four. The retrieval option clears them only CONDITIONALLY, because its eval set does not exist yet and can't until a season of real questions has been logged and labelled. That is not a formality, it is why retrieval is an option rather than a phase.

two_phase_sequencing_audit.verdict: Honest in intent, STRUCTURALLY UNSAFE as written, fixable with three specific changes. As drafted it would smuggle, not because the strategist meant it to, but because the gate has no number on it.
two_phase_sequencing_audit.the_attack: The phrase that fails is 'funded only if the phase one miss log PROVES the long tail is real'. Proves is doing all the work and nothing defines it. A miss log will ALWAYS contain misses, because any finite table has an outside. So the gate as written is satisfied by the guaranteed outcome of running the gate, which makes it unfalsifiable, and an unfalsifiable gate is decoration on a decision already taken. Worse, the party who benefits from clearing the gate is the party who designs the table that determines what counts as a miss. A narrower table produces a fatter miss log. That conflict of interest is structural and has to be disclosed and neutralised.
what_makes_it_honest: A NUMERIC THRESHOLD agreed in writing BEFORE phase one starts, capable of FAILING. A defensible form, retrieval is discussed only if at least 15 percent of logged desk questions fall outside the table, AND at least 20 distinct question types recur three or more times, AND the log holds at least 150 labelled items after de-duplication. Proposed as the shape of the gate, with the client setting final figures. What is not negotiable is that a number exists and that the gate can fail.

THE SYMMETRIC OUTCOME written into the same document. If the miss rate lands below the threshold, we say so in writing, we do not invoice, and the correct conclusion is that this business needed a rule set and not an AI, which we publish as the result rather than bury.
The table's boundaries are agreed with the client UP FRONT, so the scope of what counts as a miss is not ours to set after the fact.
The miss log is THEIR data in THEIR format, portable, and the study says so plainly. They can take it to any vendor, including one that is not us, or to nobody.
Phase one has to be worth buying standalone with no obligation, and it is.
two_phase_sequencing_audit.a_defect_the_strategist_missed: THE DATES DO NOT FIT. Phase one has to be in the cohort's hands before March 7, 2027. The miss log can only accrue while a season runs, so collection is roughly March to October 2027, labelling and build over that winter, and retrieval reaches the desk for the MARCH 2028 cohort. Presenting both phases against the same March 2027 clock quietly compresses a two season programme into one, which is exactly the direction of drift the fact-checker flagged, toward making the prospect look more ready than the evidence supports. One partial remedy costs nothing, start the paper tally now for the final nine weeks of the 2026 season.

what_carries: The MECHANISM, encoding tacit knowledge of high performers and delivering it at the moment a question arises.

The DISTRIBUTION of the effect, concentrated in novices and near zero in veterans. That is a design instruction and arguably more valuable than the headline number, because it says the rollout aims at the March cohort and deliberately does not aim at the veterans. A rollout to everyone would dilute into an average that looks like failure while the tool was working exactly as measured.
The POPULATION match, a workforce structurally reset every spring rather than a bad year.
what_does_not_carry: The MAGNITUDE. 34 percent must never be presented as Major Marine's number.

THE OUTCOME METRIC, a sharper mismatch than the strategist noticed. The study measured issues resolved per hour. The chosen outcome here is ramp time, escalation rate and misquote count, which are three different quantities. Cite i1 for who benefits and why, NEVER as a percentage attached to any Major Marine metric.

THE CHANNEL. The studied agents worked in text chat where the assistant sat literally inside the workflow. This is a phone desk. A phone agent has to read a screen while a guest waits, which raises the integration bar and changes adoption. Workflow integration is the differentiator the failure literature keeps identifying, so a channel difference is not a footnote.
THE ARTIFACT. The studied tool was continuously trained on the firm's own successful conversation transcripts. Major Marine has no transcript corpus.

THE STATISTICS OF SMALL NUMBERS, which nobody mentioned and which matters most. n was 5,179 agents. The reservations headcount here is unpublished and plausibly single digits. A mean effect across thousands says very little about what shows up in a handful of people over six weeks, where individual variation will swamp it. A reader who measures six weeks on four people and sees noise will conclude the tool failed.
nber_transfer_audit.ruling: Legitimate as DIRECTIONAL and MECHANISTIC evidence, illegitimate as a magnitude. Never write 34 percent in a sentence that also contains Major Marine's name.

miss_log_audit.verdict: The idea is right and rare, and as described it is NOT YET REAL. It is the single best thing in the strategist's proposal and it is one paragraph of specification away from being theatre.
what_would_make_it_real: Capture the question VERBATIM as asked, not a category tick.

Every entry needs a LABELLED correct answer from a named internal authority, with the source page. This is nearly always skipped and it is the step that decides whether an eval set exists. Labelling a few hundred entries is real human hours from the people who are busiest, and it belongs in the budget with a name against it.
A HELD-OUT SPLIT never looked at during development.
DELIBERATE OUT OF CORPUS CASES the system should refuse. An eval set containing only answerable questions can't measure the confident wrong answer, which is the only failure mode that hurts.
VOLUME written down in advance, roughly 150 to 300 labelled items. If a season yields 40 logged misses, there is no eval set and retrieval is not fundable on that evidence.

A FIX FOR ITS OWN SELECTION BIAS, which nobody named. The log contains only what the table missed and what a busy agent bothered to write down. Under-logging is guaranteed at peak, and peak is exactly when errors happen. The correction is cheap, a supervisor logs every question on two randomly chosen full days a month.
A PII RULE agreed before the first entry.
miss_log_audit.ruling: Keep it, and specify it to this level in the funded scope. If the labelling budget is refused, the miss log is a backlog, retrieval is unscoped, and the honest response is to say so and not build it.

voice_agent_verdict.verdict: KILL CONFIRMED. Reasoning partly OVERTURNED and rebuilt, because the strategist rested the kill on the weakest of the three available reasons.
voice_agent_verdict.why_latency_alone_is_a_weak_kill: Latency is the fastest improving variable in the stack, and the strategist's own cost of delay row concedes it. A reason to say no that EXPIRES is not a reason to say no, it is a reason to say not yet, and a vendor with a faster demo in six months can retire it in one meeting. There is also an honest counterpoint that should be stated rather than suppressed, a narrow intent set of hours, season dates and directions genuinely tolerates a 1.3 second pause, because humans pause too.
the_durable_reasons: THE LINE IS A REVENUE CHANNEL, NOT A SUPPORT QUEUE. Packages are bookable by phone only, all discounts must be booked direct, and on the verified reservation page online booking closes twelve hours out with the guest explicitly told to call. The calls being intercepted include the ones where money changes hands. Placing a bot in front of purchase intent risks revenue to save labour, which inverts the business case. This does not expire.
THE CALLER MIX SKEWS TOWARD TROUBLE. The callers most likely to need a person are the ones a bot will meet first. This does not expire either.
THE COMPOUNDING MATH, about 0.69 end to end at twelve turns.
THE SAME CONDITIONAL RULE SET WITH THE HUMAN REMOVED, making identical high-cost errors with nobody between it and the guest and no verbatim source on screen for anyone to check.
NO DENOMINATOR. Call volume is unpublished, so the candidate with the largest claimed reach has the least evidence that the reach exists.
voice_agent_verdict.what_would_change_this_answer: Two things TOGETHER. Measured call volume and mix showing a large genuinely routine intent that is neither a sale nor a disruption, and a platform independently measured near 800ms on this workload. Even then the honest first build is a narrow after hours intent handler with instant handoff, and it comes AFTER the internal answer layer, never before it.

honest_wins: THE DECISION TABLE WILL WORK, and it deserves the same force as any kill. The rarest thing in an AI proposal, a component whose acceptance bar is PROVABLE rather than sampled. Zero hallucination surface on precisely the questions where a wrong answer costs the most.

THE NOVICE CONCENTRATION FINDING IS REAL AND MATCHES THIS COMPANY UNUSUALLY WELL. Tier one, 5,179 agents, gains concentrated in novices and near zero in veterans. About 60 seasonal staff hired inside a three month window every year is the population that finding describes. Solid ground, read for direction and for who to aim at.

THE SAME CATEGORY SIGNAL POINTS AT THE INTERNAL BUILD, WHICH IS THE OPPOSITE OF WHAT THE VENDOR IS SELLING. A named day-cruise chief executive describing a staff member getting her answer from the bot rather than from him is tier three vendor-published evidence and a quote rather than a measurement, and should be labelled exactly that way. Even at that tier the INVERSION is real information, the bot was bought to serve guests and its reported side effect was training staff.

SNIPPET RETRIEVAL GENUINELY HELPS A FIRST WEEK HIRE. Their failure is not an inability to read, it is not knowing which of roughly thirty pages the answer lives on when the veterans have gone home. Search returning the verbatim sentence and the page fixes that exact failure with one fallible step and a modelled rate of about one wrong answer reaching a guest in eighty three. It may never need a generation step on top.
THE CORPUS EXISTS, removing half of the most common killer before the project starts. Most companies quoting this build are starting from PDFs and a phone system.

THE CORPUS RECONCILIATION IS A WIN IN ITS OWN RIGHT, not a tax on the AI project. One canonical, dated, owned policy source improves the website, the two hotel front desks and the dock, on a day when no software has been installed anywhere.

THE REVIEW RESPONSE FINDING IS FREE MONEY SAVED AND SHOULD BE GIVEN AWAY. In the channel everybody is currently being sold, tooling to answer reviews buys nothing measurable. Worth more to them than most things with a price on them.

THE TALLY SHEET IS A WIN THEY CAN START THIS WEEK AT ZERO COST. Nine weeks of the 2026 season remain. If it turns out their desk barely escalates anything, that is a finding that saves them the entire project, and we would rather find it in September than in March.
notes: CONSTRAINT COMPLIANCE. Nothing cites the Google aggregate, the Indeed rating, the field-wide no-self-serve-cancellation observation, the cruise terminal figures, or any competitor booking platform finding, all uncovered by the gate. The booking vendor is never named. No tenure number is attached to Tom Tougas. The check-in rule is treated as HANDLED and only the late train as manual. Nothing implies a guest ever complained.
The website defects are used ONLY as evidence for corpus readiness, which is where they legitimately belong, and never as a headline or an opener.

The vessel named in the FAQ on the 12:30 pm departure is treated throughout as an UNRESOLVED discrepancy, used to show the vessel map has no single authoritative home, never to assert what the vessel is or is not.

The four failure studies were NOT deployed as an argument that AI does not work. They were used for the specific mechanisms they identify. honest_wins is written to the same standard of rigour as the kill list rather than as a courtesy paragraph.

ONE DIRECTION OF DRIFT FOR DOWNSTREAM. Across the strategist's file the small imprecisions lean toward the prospect being MORE READY than the evidence supports, the two phase timeline being the clearest case. That direction is the finding, not any single instance.

FOR THE ROI ANALYST. Do not model an hours-saved case on a desk whose headcount is unpublished. The honest case is ramp time and error rate, recurring every spring, and the error rate side has no baseline until the tally sheet runs. Any hours figure before then is an invented denominator.

FOR THE STAFF ENGINEER. Three things must be enforced IN CODE rather than in a prompt. The red list topic filter routing refunds, accessibility, shuttle eligibility and dietary questions to the table before any retriever runs. The assertion that no answer returns without a verbatim source and URL. The season scoping of every dated or priced fact, since two seasons are live at once.

FOR THE DELIVERY LEAD. The Later lane should carry, in this order, the guest-facing chatbot gated on a season of internal evidence, the disruption batch mode gated on a counted event frequency, the package configurator gated on a conversation about whether phone-only is deliberate, and the seat allocation question gated on any evidence at all that it hurts.
